name: opensearch-agent-right-to-be-forgotten
description: A privacy-engineering agent skill for OpenSearch that finds and erases personal data by INDIRECT contextual identification — locating documents that identify a person without their name or direct IDs ever appearing (e.g. 'the solo frontend engineer on duty during incident #4091'). Uses hybrid BM25 + neural/vector search to surface candidates, agent-driven contextual disambiguation to score them, and dry-run / redact-in-place / hard-delete actions with an append-only audit trail. Just ask your AI assistant to fulfil a GDPR erasure or right-to-be-forgotten request against your logs, traces, or documents.
